chapter_title: Lab: Eval Harness with Slices and Regression Tracking
course_outline_concepts: Build a minimal harness covering 3 tasks across reasoning/chat/safety with slice reporting
Add contamination gate: fail-if-n-gram-overlap exceeds threshold against your training set
Add judge-bias probe: position-swap subset + length-controlled pairs
Run your ch-34 SFT + ch-44 RL checkpoints through the harness; write a comparative memo
Deliverable: harness code + contamination report + eval-memo.md with go/no-go recommendation
Resource-constrained path: one reasoning task + one safety task; precomputed rollouts
role_in_track: Capstone of the Eval track. Integrates everything from ch-47..ch-52 (slice reporting, bootstrap CI, contamination, judge bias, long-context, tool-use eval) into a single runnable harness. Produces the go/no-go memo format that ch-55..ch-60 (infra track) and the RL labs in ch-45..ch-46 will call from their CI.

sources.what_to_extract: Separation of target behavior / attack wrapper / success classifier; 7 semantic + 4 functional categories; validation/test split; held-out Llama-2-13B-Chat classifier over substring matching; contextual + multimodal behaviors as harder slices.

Refusal as its own label; matched refusal/compliance pairs; GPT-4 label audit (92/82/95% agreement); WildGuardTest 1,725 pairs with three-annotator majority vote; 13 risk subcategories for slice reporting.

Three biases (position ~20-30%, verbosity, self-enhancement); swap-and-average two-game mitigation; length-controlled pairs; reference-guided grading +10pp; never use candidate model as judge; agreement parity with humans (~80%).
ExactSubstr >=50 tokens; NearDup MinHash 9000 sigs, 20 bands x 450 rows, Jaccard ~0.8; 4.6% LM1B / 3.2% C4 train-test overlap; this is the operational definition of the contamination gate.
Data quality as explicit scaling variable; effective sample size; motivation for slice-level reporting (two corpora same token count, different quality curves).
OLMES eval stack + OlmoTrace + decontamination utility as an example of a lab-grade harness that ships alongside checkpoints; staged evals across SFT -> DPO -> RLVR branches.
Silent failure framing; 'review the 10 worst validation examples'; overfit-one-batch discipline applied to eval harness (run the harness end-to-end on one example before sweeping).
Synthetic-generator framework: vary length and complexity independently; 13 task configurations; recall-based matching; 500 examples per task per length; effective context size metric.
AST matcher for tool calls; relevance-detection sub-score; pass^k metric; V2 Live real queries over synthetic; multi-category scoring separates function choice from argument filling.

deliverables: read.md (220-280 lines, lab brief with Goal, Full-budget path, Resource-constrained path, 7 sections, Acceptance criteria, Connections, Further reading, Companion visualization)
figures/eval-pipeline.html (self-contained interactive pipeline: config -> task run -> slice aggregate -> contamination gate -> judge probe -> memo; click-through IO examples; 200-280 lines; no CDN)
